title: Future purchase and recommendation intentions
summary: The topic centers on owners’ future intentions to keep, repurchase, or recommend BMW, with one negative note about traffic prediction performance and many statements that are intention-focused rather than clearly evaluative.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention willingness to recommend BMW or describe a personal buying stance without active recommendation.

negative.summary: Negative feedback is limited to a complaint that the system did not detect future traffic problems quickly enough.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly state plans to keep the car, buy BMW again, or avoid switching back, but these fragments do not clearly express evaluative sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are intention statements rather than clear opinions, which limits confident interpretation of customer sentiment.
The topic mixes future purchase loyalty, recommendation intent, ownership duration, transmission preference, and one traffic guidance issue rather than a single tightly focused subject.
